pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions (pyramiding) within 30 minutes of a prior stopped order; scale-ins only permitted after price confirms a 2x ATR impulse in favor.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block and volume-weighted average price (VWAP) cross validation before entry; block all trades when spread exceeds 35% of the 14-period ATR.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated partial profit harvesting at +$10.00 and dynamic trailing lockdown at +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric win-to-loss ratios.
